query:
SELECT count(*) AS "count!: i64"
           FROM chats c
           WHERE c.user_id = $1
             AND NOT c.temporary
             AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                             FROM json_each($2) w
                             WHERE c.title NOT LIKE w.value ESCAPE '\'
                               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                               FROM messages m
                                               WHERE m.chat_id = c.id
                                                 AND m.content LIKE w.value ESCAPE '\'))
